verdict.rationale: Fastmail can be driven without its UI through its JMAP API. Requests are plain HTTP POSTs of `methodCalls` and authenticate with standard OAuth or Bearer tokens. Fastmail also documents API tokens and has an API documentation page, and one community user runs automated transactional sending over SMTP with a scoped app password. Most protocol detail comes from the generic jmap.io site, though, and the Fastmail token docs appear only as titles; the terminal client listed on jmap.io is ecosystem tooling, not Fastmail's. Missing for 10: a first-party CLI or headless/CI usage guide, detailed Fastmail-specific token scoping docs, and hands-on corroboration of CI automation through the API.
